comparison.objective: Close an instrument case and fasten two draw latches by seating hooks, tensioning levers, and closing safety catches; candidate finishes four thread inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential hook engagement, latch tensioning, and safety-catch closure versus precision mandrel alignment, separately controlled hammering, fracture regulation, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Each hook must be seated before its lever is flattened, both safeties closed, and the lid held versus four contact-loaded fractures, all tangs contained, and no damage.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record in assembly character, but it tests multi-stage latching rather than impact fracture and cleanup. No spec versions or numeric latch tolerances are included.
